en_title: Kane Parsons Confirms Meetings With Valve, But Won't Adapt Their Games If It Can't Be Done Right
subtitle: 先聊创意，不急定案
opus_summary: 《后室》导演Kane Parsons确认曾与Valve会面，但强调做不好就不改编其游戏。双方交流仍是开放式创意讨论，《传送门》电影能否成行尚无定论。

paragraphs.en: Backrooms director Kane Parsons has confirmed his meetings with Valve, but says that he has no plans to adapt any of their games if it can't be done well.
paragraphs.cn: 《后室》导演Kane Parsons确认曾与Valve会面，但表示如果做不好，他就不打算改编该公司的任何游戏。

paragraphs.en: When speaking on an October 28 episode of The Kyle Buchanan Show , Parsons wore a Valve hoodie, which prompted Buchanan to inquire about Parsons' recent trips to the developer's corporate offices. (Following the release of Backrooms, the director noted that he wanted to make a Portal movie and subsequently posted about trips to Valve on Instagram .) Naturally, Parsons didn't confirm or deny what exactly is going on between them, but confirmed that he has had conversations with the company — but he only wants to work with them if it's done right.
paragraphs.cn: 在10月28日播出的《The Kyle Buchanan Show》中，Parsons身穿一件Valve连帽衫，Buchanan因此问起了他最近几次造访这家开发商总部的事。（《后室》上映后，这位导演曾表示想拍一部《传送门》电影，随后又在Instagram上发帖分享了造访Valve的行程。）不出所料，Parsons没有证实或否认双方究竟在做什么，但确认自己确实与这家公司有过交流。不过，他只愿意在能把事情做好的前提下与他们合作。

paragraphs.en: "They work in experiments, and I like that, because that tends to be how I work," he said. "I don't have a desire to sensationalize anything I may or may not be talking to them about over there, because it's mainly: Is it possible to make something compelling in some way that we like? What do you guys want to do? What do I want to do? Is there anything on the table in any way, shape, or form?
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「他们通过实验来开展工作，我很喜欢这一点，因为我通常也是这样工作的。我不想炒作自己可能与他们谈过、也可能没谈过的任何事情，因为我们主要聊的是：能不能做出某种既吸引人、又让我们喜欢的东西？你们想做什么？我想做什么？有没有任何形式的可行方向？」

paragraphs.en: "And if it's not, I would defend a future where we don't even go down that road, but it's more like having an abstract creative conversation that could flow in like 30 different directions. If you know the way Valve works, I think they're looking to experiment more internally than anything that's going to be talked about. If something cool comes of it, I am sure somehow, people will know."
paragraphs.cn: 「如果没有，我也会支持今后干脆不走这条路。不过，我们更像是在抽象地聊创意，话题可能延伸出大概30个不同方向。如果你了解Valve的工作方式，我觉得比起拿出来谈论，他们更希望在内部多做些实验。如果最终有了什么很酷的成果，我相信大家总会以某种方式知道的。」

paragraphs.en: As noted, Parsons has expressed interest in making a Portal movie and also recently confirmed that he is working on three "dream projects." These projects seem to be linked to some kind of IP, but Parsons has also previously stated he has no real interest in a property like Star Wars, and his desire for adaptations lies more within a small handful of things from his childhood, such as Valve's games.
paragraphs.cn: 如前所述，Parsons曾表示有兴趣拍摄《传送门》电影，最近也确认自己正在推进三个「梦想项目」。这些项目似乎都与某些IP有关，不过Parsons此前也说过，他对《星球大战》这类IP并没有太大兴趣。他想改编的，更多是童年接触过的少数几部作品，比如Valve的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Whether a Portal movie actually happens remains to be seen, but it's good to hear that Parsons isn't simply trying to jack the franchise from Valve. Although there hasn't been a new mainline Portal game since 2011, interest in the series remains high among fans. Perhaps a film could inspire a new game... or maybe Parsons has ambitions beyond a movie and would like to do something with the game's developers, instead. He has extensive experience with Blender, so he isn't out of his element, after all.
paragraphs.cn: 《传送门》电影究竟能否成行，还有待观察，但听到Parsons并不是一心想从Valve手里抢走这个系列，还是让人欣慰。虽然《传送门》自2011年以来就没有推出过新的正传游戏，但粉丝对这个系列的热情依然很高。或许一部电影能催生一款新游戏……又或许Parsons的志向不止于电影，而是想与游戏开发者一起做点什么。毕竟，他有丰富的Blender使用经验，也不算是跨入完全陌生的领域。
